name: Laszlo Kovacs
bio:
Laszlo's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in Budapest, where he spent countless hours tinkering with his father's vintage Lada. This early exposure ignited a passion for mechanics and engineering, leading him to pursue a degree in Automotive Engineering. After graduating, Laszlo gained valuable experience working for a local tuning shop, honing his skills in fabrication and welding. 

Driven by his desire to contribute to a competitive racing environment, Laszlo joined Trident Motorsport two years ago. He approaches every task with meticulous attention to detail and a relentless pursuit of perfection. Laszlo's loyalty and dedication to the team make him a valued asset, always willing to go the extra mile to ensure the cars are performing at their peak. He is known for his innovative problem-solving skills, often devising ingenious solutions to complex technical challenges. Colleagues recognize Laszlo as a mentor because he is always willing to share his expertise, guiding junior team members with patience and clarity. 

Laszlo believes that success in motorsport hinges on a combination of cutting-edge technology and unwavering teamwork. He strives to foster a collaborative environment, where every member feels empowered to contribute their unique talents. He takes immense pride in his craft, knowing that every part he fabricates plays a crucial role in the team's pursuit of victory.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Laszlo is a man of medium build with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils before starting any task, no matter how small.
